Title: SAP HANA backup using Azure Backup is now GA in UK South region

Body.Content:
The Azure Backup solution to backup SAP HANA DBs in Azure VMs is now generally available in UK South region. You can now seamlessly backup SAP HANA DBs in M-series VMs, in scale-up mode and in SLES OS Azure Virtual machines without any additional backup infrastructure. 

For more information on the backup solution pricing, refer to the Azure Backup Pricing Page.

The solution is BackInt certified for HANA running on single-node i.e., Scale-up Azure VMs. You can easily do a system refresh with a click of a button and leverage Central management capabilities of Azure Backup to monitor SAP HANA backups as well. For more information on backing up SAP HANA in Azure VMs, please refer to the SAP HANA backup using Azure Backup documentation.

Learn more
